title: I built a full ecosystem for Seamless Textures and PBR Mapping
author: Frosty_Trainer_8490
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I’ve been messing around with AI for textures lately, and the biggest frustration I had was the lack of control. Most tools just spit out a flat image that you can't actually use in-engine without a ton of manual cleanup.

I spent the last few weeks building **Playtex AI** to fix that. Instead of just "prompt-to-image," I focused on an AI/deterministic hybrid with generating with AI to Texture and Image to Texture tools.

It also generates the full PBR stack (Normal, Roughness, AO, Height) so it’s actually export-ready for Unreal/Unity (NO AI, fully deterministic).

In addition, I added a "Procedural Surface Lab" where you can actually mess with surface families and aging/wear timelines, or hybrid mode where you can add different effects to your pre-made textures.

It’s currently live at [playtex.ai](https://www.playtex.ai/home) and I’d love to get some feedback from other game designers/devs. Is this something that would actually speed up your workflow?
